example_sentences_in_bangla: দেশকে এক করার জন্য নেতৃত্ব দরকার।
পারিবারিক ঝগড়া এক করতে সময় লাগবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Leadership is needed to unite the country.
It will take time to unite the family feud.
history: Often invoked in contexts of national division, such as the 1947 Partition of India or the Bangladesh Liberation War, symbolizing efforts to reunite a fractured populace.
note: The idiom emphasizes collective harmony in divided contexts.
